def GetTickText_deprecated(tick):
    """ GetTickText(tick)
    
    Obtain text from a tick. Convert to exponential notation 
    if necessary. 
    
    """
    
    # Correct -0: 0 has on some systems been reported to be shown as -0
    if tick == -0:
        tick = 0
    # Get text
    text = '%1.4g' % tick
    iExp = text.find('e')
    if iExp>0:
        front = text[:iExp+2]
        text = front + text[iExp+2:].lstrip('0')
    return text
